items.raw_excerpt: The NRL team, the first from WA since 1997, did not give a reason for his departure.
items.summary_en: The CEO of the Perth Bears has stepped down. The team is the first NRL club from Western Australia since 1997. The club did not say why he left.

items.title_en: Perth Bears CEO Anthony De Ceglie steps down

items.raw_excerpt: Why one teen can't let go of the time he ate fries with his great-grandpa.
items.summary_en: A student shares a small memory that he cannot let go of. He once ate fries with his great-grandpa. The story looks at why our minds hold on to moments like this.
items.summary_ko: 한 학생이 쉽게 잊지 못하는 작은 기억을 들려준다. 그는 증조할아버지와 감자튀김을 함께 먹은 적이 있었다. 이 이야기는 우리가 왜 이런 순간을 마음에 오래 담아 두는지 살펴본다.
items.title_en: A Teen Remembers Eating Fries With His Great-Grandpa
